principles: CSDL model should NOT include <Schema Namespace="Agent">: vocabulary definitions belong in external standard vocabularies, not inlined in domain/service CSDL.
CSDL model should NOT include annotations for tools (Agent.Tools): tools are projected client/agent adapters over native OData operations (Actions/Functions), not CSDL schema elements.
Proposal focuses strictly on Agent.Prompts annotations on the EntityContainer (and optional Agent.ExampleQueries on EntitySets) to define prompt templates and agent workflows.

methodology: Option 1 (Baseline Server B) uses a CSDL without @Agent.Prompts annotations (exposing only tools and resources projected from standard OData EntitySets and Singletons). Option 2 (Variant Server A) uses a CSDL with container @Agent.Prompts only (containing OData v4.01 query steps, with no examples in CSDL). Baseline B completes before Variant A. Fresh CLI home/work directory per query; only assigned MCP enabled. Catalogs are fetched from the running servers. Success requires matching intent, actual tool call, expected parameters/paths and non-error MCP response, or correct unsupported-request rejection. Generated OData strings are not executed or scored.
